[[File:Unkwldtemple.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Temple of the Ancients on Lehon]]
'''Rakatan temples'''<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> were structures built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] on several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Numerous temples were erected, including the [[Temple of the Ancients]] located on the Rakatan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]],<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Honoghr Rakatan temple|another temple]] on the planet of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]],<ref name="Republic 68">[[Republic 68|''Republic'' 68]]</ref> and a number of temples on [[Generis/Legends|Generis]].<ref name="TLCSB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
